title: Heart Sutra
subtitle: A Buddhist Prajñāpāramitā scripture
timeLabel: Chinese translation and circulation: Sui–Tang focus
shortSummary: The Heart Sutra presents Prajñāpāramitā thought in a highly condensed form and became one of the most widely circulated texts in Chinese Buddhism.
curatorialDescription: The museum records the Heart Sutra's text, versions, transmission and later recitation separately instead of treating a popular line as a context-free maxim.
researchNote: Specific translators, editions and variant readings will be verified passage by passage in the next editorial batch.
